about: The Jupiter Farms parade is a neighborhood tradition that the Jupiter Elks Lodge has chosen to keep going, and the 2026 edition keeps the same format: a morning parade followed by an afternoon craft fair at the lodge.

Craft fair booths are limited to homemade, enhanced or changed items, so the tables are mostly handmade gifts rather than mass produced goods, and the lodge also collects raffle and silent auction items for the fair.
faq: Do you have to be an Elks member to attend?
No. The Jupiter Elks Lodge says non-members are welcome to come as guests.
It starts on 160th Rd N, also called Rudolph Sighting, at 133rd and heads east past Haynie Lane to Randolph Siding.
Parade awards are given out at the Elks Lodge at 3 PM on December 5, during the craft fair.
